messages:
Alex C: quick cross-team check — where are we on the v2 rollout bridge for partner APIs? need clear owners for slice 7-9, the deprecation cutoff, and the sdk header tweak. planning to flip feature-flag wed EOD unless there are blockers. @Maria G @Samir K @Jin P please confirm.

Maria G: slice 7 (ingest) is green from product/tests perspective. infra flagged a proxy header fallback gap — filing ticket INF-2917. ETA for infra patch is Tue 12:00 UTC. will add smoke tests when patch lands.

Samir K: sdk update: header rename landed in 0.9.3 but it's currently opt-in (config flag). docs PR is up (#456). question: do we want the SDK to auto-translate old->new header, or rely on an infra compat shim? auto-translate is easy but risks hiding client bugs.

Jin P: prefer infra compat shim. translating at SDK level complicates rollbacks and makes telemetry noisy. if infra does shim we can add a metric for converted requests. propose telemetry label: `v2_rollout:shim=true`.

Lisa (ops): heads-up — current LB dedupe rule will drop requests if header changes without a patch. ops can patch but need exact header key name. Samir, can you paste the header keys you plan to use?

Samir K: sure — current plan: `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2`, fallback header to accept: `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` (opt-in backwards). snippet: `{"headers": {"X-Redwood-API-Version": "v2", "X-Redwood-Compat": "v1"}}`

Alex C: decision for this thread: go with proxy shim (INF-2917) + ops LB patch for dedupe. Samir keep SDK change opt-in (0.9.3) and ship docs; do NOT enable auto-translate by default. Maria add telemetry check to slice-7 smoke: ensure we see `v2_rollout:shim` metric. Lisa schedule LB patch Tue morning and confirm when done.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: slice-7 smoke canary deploy -> 2024-07-09T14:00:00Z.

Jin P: also — deprecation policy reminder: clients not migrated by 2024-08-15 will be throttled to v1-rate and receive warning headers. need comms plan.

Paula M: got it, i'll draft email + devblog + in-product notice this afternoon. will coordinate copy with Maria.

Alex C: owners summary (for clarity): Alex C (coord), Maria G (slice-7 lead / tests), Samir K (SDK & docs), Jin P (reliability / metrics), Lisa (ops / LB), Paula M (comms). if no blockers reported by Tue 12:00 UTC we proceed to flip feature-flag Wed EOD for slices 7-9. please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.
